content_sections.heading: CUO Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
CUO Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CUO Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CUO Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty positions at the Central University of Odisha is scheduled for 18 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Guest Faculty position in the Central University of Odisha recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Guest Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Sc. in Agriculture with at least 55% marks, a Master's degree in a relevant Agriculture subject with at least 55% marks, and NET (CSIR/ICAR/UGC) or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for the CUO Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The salary is offered on a per-lecture basis, with Rs. 1500 per lecture, and a maximum monthly earning of Rs. 50000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty role at CUO?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty positions will be based on a Walk-in Interview conducted by the Central University of Odisha.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for CUO Guest Faculty recruitment to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Central University of Odisha office in Koraput, Odisha (Pin code: 763004).

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The Guest Faculty positions are contractual in nature, as per the official notification released by the Central University of Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. Does the Central University of Odisha provide age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any such provisions.
